text:
Ravi Gupta: FYI console telemetry shows a correlated spike in SLO breach rate and tenant quota rejections after the routing change at 02:10. Not pages yet but noisy cards.
Nina Torres: Which metric chain? quota.rejections or proxy.latency?
Ravi Gupta: quota.rejections for tenant:acme-inc AND p99 latency on /chat/complete. They seem to coincide with route steering to fallback pool.
Ethan B: If steering moved traffic to a lower-capacity pool the SLO eval window (60s) will see many short breaches. We probably need a 'soft alert' state for routing-caused contention.
Priya S: Soft alert idea: surface a yellow advisory in SLO card and don't increment burn unless breach persists across 5m aggregated window. That avoids immediate notify churn.
Marta L: UX question: will teams miss real incidents if we delay burn? need a clear visual and audit trail.
Nina Torres: We can add a 'soft' flag in the internal API: POST /api/internal/slo/eval?soft=true and emit metric slo.eval.soft=true. Then console can render differently.
Ravi Gupta: Example: 
```
PATCH /api/internal/slo/1234
{"evaluation_window":"5m","soft_mode":true}
```
Ethan B: API debate: do we make soft_mode a per-eval flag or a per-tenant policy? Per-tenant is powerful but complicates rollout.
Priya S: Start with per-route toggle in console, so teams opt-in per-route. We'll bake per-tenant later.
Marta L: Also add a tooltip on the SLO card: "Soft alerts delay burn for short flaps. Click to view raw breach events."
Nina Torres: Telemetry: add a timeseries 'slo.soft_exposed' and retention label so we can query how often it suppresses burn.
Ravi Gupta: Ops-bot can we annotate current runbook to mention soft alerts so oncall knows why no page?
ops-bot: Created runbook note 'soft-alerts-explainer' and attached to SLO 1234. Link: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/soft-alerts
Ethan B: For routing policies: when steering to fallback, we should temporarily widen eval_window or auto-enable soft_mode. That can be an automated policy in router.
Priya S: Agree. Add a console toggle 'auto-soft-on-fallback' with default off. Product teams can flip when using staged rollouts.
Marta L: Need audit entries for auto toggles too. People will want to know why their SLOs behaved differently during rollout.
Nina Torres: Also need to ensure notify pipeline respects soft flag: no pages, but still emit advisory emails to owner list.
Ravi Gupta: Good point. Email vs pager split should be configurable: soft -> email only; hard -> pager+email.
Ethan B: Implementation note: notify pipeline currently dedups by fingerprint + 60s. We'll add a notify.score and threshold for page. If soft_mode true, raise score threshold by +10.
Priya S: Can we ship an A/B test? Half tenants with soft enabled during next router rollout. We'll monitor false negative rate.
Marta L: UX: show a compact sparkline in SLO card with raw events toggle so engineers can expand to see 1s resolution if needed.
Nina Torres: Telemetry retention: raw events keep 24h, aggregated keep 90d. Make sure queries in console use aggregated for default to avoid slowness.
Ravi Gupta: Action items: Ethan -> prototype notify.score change, Nina -> add slo.soft_exposed metric and retention labels, Priya -> console toggle mock, Marta -> tooltip + audit UI, ops-bot -> attach runbook note. Revisit in 30m.
Priya S: I'll sketch the mock and put in figma. linking soon.
ops-bot: Runbook note attached and test email sent to #eng-platform-staging.
Ravi Gupta: Thanks all, let's keep the noise down during the rollout.
